description: Checks a MapLibre style against the MapLibre Style Specification and lists every problem, each with the path to the property it is about. Run it after editing a style. Pass the style as an object, a URL or a file path.

path.description: Path to a style JSON file, relative to the directory the server runs in.

style.description: The style as a JSON object.

url.description: URL of a style JSON document.

name: validate_style
title: Validate style
